_readme: THE EARTH FROM ORBIT -- the whole planet from 20,000 km, the eye on the radial through the
Merrimack, north up, looking at the planet's centre. Every drag gesture turns ABOUT THE
PLANET'S CENTRE (the camera rotor, 2026-10-10): the pan keeps the point under the cursor by
one turn about the centre line, rotate and tilt take the radial through the grabbed point as
the vertical, and no gesture sinks the eye. The scroll wheel closes the range; the planet's
buildings fold up to meet the eye as it comes down (docs/BUILDING_LOD.md).
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/earth.json
The view is the KML-named placement {lat, lon, alt, heading, tilt, roll, range}: all zero
looks at the centre, north up; `range` is the eye's distance from the point.
